record.title: Eeyore: Realistic Depression Simulation via Expert-in-the-Loop Supervised and Preference Optimization
record.reason: Primary mental-health clinical-training study. Physical pp1,3,7–10 describe depression-client simulation with expert-guided curation, supervised training and preference optimization. Preference annotation used mental-health professionals/senior clinical-psychology students; final evaluation used 15 experienced counsellors/senior psychology students on authenticity and depression-profile adherence. Sources include RED, HOPE, ESC and AnnoMI, and emotional-distress inclusion does not imply every original speaker had a verified clinical diagnosis. Results evaluate a simulator rather than treatment efficacy, and the paper reports hallucination/educational-error risks and limited expert sample size.
